name: The Prophecy of Mosh'aru

faq.answer: Yeh'kinya, a troll scholar in the sands of Tanaris, asks for them.
faq.q: Who is asking for the tablets?

aliases: why does yehkinya want the tablets
faq.answer: Yeh'kinya intends to study the ancient writings to learn how to contain the essence of Hakkar.
faq.q: Why does Yeh'kinya want the tablets?

faq.answer: He requires the First and Second Mosh'aru Tablets, which hold the ancient prophecy.
Yeh'kinya is stationed in the desert land of Tanaris.

sections.body: Yeh'kinya waits among the dunes of Tanaris for two pieces of the ancient prophecy. He believes the writings on the First and Second Mosh'aru Tablets hold hidden truths that can be unlocked once brought together. With them in hand, the troll scholar hopes to uncover a way to contain the essence of the Blood God Hakkar.
sections.title: Secrets in the Stone

sections.body: Bringing the ancient stone slabs together allows Yeh'kinya to mend them into a single tablet. Once joined, he can delve into their forgotten knowledge and prepare for the dangers surrounding Hakkar's return.
sections.title: Mending the Prophecy

summary: In Tanaris, the troll scholar Yeh'kinya seeks the First and Second Mosh'aru Tablets. He needs their ancient writings to learn how to contain the essence of Hakkar before the Blood God can rise.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Prophecy of Mosh'aru
